It provides approximately 7,000 types and more than 660,000 units of rental assets (ownership ratio by category: vehicles 28%, aerial work vehicles and machinery 23%, excavators and road paving machinery 16%, lifting and transport machinery 11%, generators, compressors and environmental products 10%, tools and electrical and surveying equipment 6%, lighting, safety equipment and materials 6%) from the company's 69 domestic sales offices and from subsidiaries in Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam.
